title: [FI] Delocalize Depreciation Differences into a first-party extension
summary: Finland's Depreciation Differences feature moves from the base application into a first-party extension app, with legacy code marked obsolete and scheduled for removal in version 33.
key_points: New extension app DepreciationDifferencesFI provides depreciation differences functionality with table extensions, page extensions, reports, and codeunits
Legacy BaseApp implementation marked obsolete (pending in 30.0, removed in 33.0) and wrapped behind CLEAN30 guards to support transitional migration
Feature uses a feature key (DepreciationDifferencesFI) and upgrade codeunit to migrate data from legacy schema until CLEANSCHEMA33
Helper procedures shared between migration paths avoid code duplication during transition period
Extension integrates with Contoso Coffee demo data and hybrid cloud migration infrastructure

obsoletions.replacement: Calc. and Post Depr. Diff. FI in DepreciationDifferencesFI extension
Depr. Diff. Posting Buffer FI in DepreciationDifferencesFI extension

quote: Delocalizes the Finland Depreciation Differences regulatory feature from the FI BaseApp layer into a new first-party extension app.
